:::{#sol-affine-map-practice}

Yes.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1},
\qquad
\vec{b} = \sbmat{1 \\ -3}.
$$

By @def-matvec-mult,
$\matr{A}\vx = \tp{(2 x_1, x_2)}$,
so

$$
\matr{A}\vx + \vec{b} = \sbmat{2 x_1 + 1 \\ x_2 - 3} = f(\vx)
$$

for every $\vx \in \reals^2$.
So $f$ is an [affine map](#def-affine-map).

:::
